NUDGE_AUTH_KEY.description: Required login password/token. Leave blank in the guided setup to generate one automatically; it is saved locally once.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required session signing secret. The guided setup generates this automatically.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Required push public key. The guided setup generates the VAPID pair automatically.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Required push private key. The guided setup generates the VAPID pair automatically.

NUDGE_PROFILE_NAME.description: Optional initial display name, for example Junior. You can change it later in Nudge Settings.

APP_TIMEZONE.description: Optional initial IANA timezone, for example Asia/Kolkata. You can change it later in Nudge Settings.

NUDGE_ASSISTANT_GENDER.description: Optional assistant voice persona: she or he. Defaults to she.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Add a Google AI Studio API key to enable the live voice assistant. Leave blank to disable.

SECOND_BRAIN_URL.description: Optional. URL of your deployed Second Brain Worker. Leave blank to disable memories.

SECOND_BRAIN_TOKEN.description: Optional. Use the authentication token from that Second Brain deployment. Leave blank to disable.

EMAIL_MCP_URL.description: Optional. URL of your private Email MCP Worker. Leave blank to disable email.

EMAIL_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Cloudflare Access service-token Client ID for the Email MCP Worker.

EMAIL_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional secret. Cloudflare Access service-token Client Secret for the Email MCP Worker.

EMAIL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Optional secret. Shared action-signing secret generated by the guided email setup.
